name: edge-systems-monorepo
description: Standardized, linked monorepo for the five Edge Systems applications

scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix barter-bridge && npm run build --prefix diagnostic-liquidity && npm run build --prefix horizon-scrape && npm run build --prefix parametric-pulse && npm run build --prefix sacrificial-pathways
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix barter-bridge && npm install --prefix diagnostic-liquidity && npm install --prefix horizon-scrape && npm install --prefix parametric-pulse && npm install --prefix sacrificial-pathways
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint --prefix barter-bridge && npm run lint --prefix diagnostic-liquidity && npm run lint --prefix horizon-scrape && npm run lint --prefix parametric-pulse && npm run lint --prefix sacrificial-pathways

author: Edge Systems Team
